testCommand: javac -d out $(find src -name '*.java') && java -cp out TestRunner
preserve: // Blank lines are skipped; the exports pad the end of the file with them.
notes: A good fix replaces the line-based parser with a character-level state machine that treats a doubled quote as a literal quote and keeps line breaks inside quoted fields, while still counting physical lines for error reporting. The pre-existing comment about blank lines explains why they are dropped and should survive.
